exitCriteria: A stable 1.x release, or the Sites toolchain documenting a supported App Router adapter that is not Vinext

upgradeMatrix.proves: Vite, RSC/SSR environments, and the Worker entry still compile from the App Router source
Route handlers, identity derivation, and header policy contracts under the new adapter

upgradeMatrix.command: npm run check:performance:d1 && npm run check:recovery:d1
upgradeMatrix.proves: D1 binding, migrations, optimistic concurrency, and local recovery through the built Worker
Complete journeys, accessibility, and route smoke against the production build
Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit responsive contracts on the built Worker
Approved Linux Chromium baselines are unchanged by the adapter
Sites identity headers, security and API headers, and signed-out route matrix on the deployed version

rollbackTriggers: Any upgrade-matrix command fails on the exact candidate SHA
Hosted smoke fails on a required route, header, or provenance check
Sites identity headers are missing or mis-derived on the deployed version
A D1 write path returns errors or loses optimistic-concurrency behavior
